facts.fact: Vanguard reports a newly enacted National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) Act, which it dates 2025 (the other sources date it 2026), as the legal foundation for the digital identity system; the document gives no enactment date, so its publication date is used.
facts.system: NIMC Act (given as 2025 in the document)

facts.fact: The NIMC Director-General says the newly enacted NIMC Act provides the legal framework for secure digital authentication, interoperability and trusted digital services across government; the document gives no date for the statement, so its publication date is used.
facts.system: NIMC Act (given as 2025 in the document)

systems.tiers: Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, primary healthcare centres, National Health Insurance programme (planned)
